title: Algerian Peanut Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious Algerian-inspired stir fry made with peanuts, vegetables, and spices. Serve hot over rice or noodles.

ingredients.name: stir-fry vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli

ingredients.name: creamy nutmeg
ingredients.notes: ground nutmeg adds a warm, creamy flavor

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Heat the peanut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the stir-fry vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the creamy nutmeg, Algerian spice blend, and peanuts. Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Serve hot over rice or noodles and enjoy!
